mcqs.question: Under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, what is the role of the Designated Authority?
options: To take over and manage foreign contributions and assets of bodies whose registration is cancelled, surrendered or expired
To approve all foreign contributions before they are received by any organisation
To conduct magisterial inquiries into custodial deaths
To regulate the registration of online games
mcqs.explanation: The Designated Authority takes over and manages the foreign contributions and assets of bodies whose registration is cancelled, surrendered or expired. Approval of online games is a function associated with the Online Gaming Authority, not the Designated Authority.

mcqs.question: What principle regarding procedure was established in the Maneka Gandhi case in the context of constitutional safeguards?
options: Procedure must be fair, just and reasonable
The State must compensate for every custodial death
Arrest must not be arbitrary
CCTV is mandatory in police stations
mcqs.explanation: The Maneka Gandhi case held that procedure must be fair, just and reasonable. The other options refer respectively to Nilabati Behera, Joginder Kumar and Paramvir Singh Saini.

mcqs.question: What was held in Nilabati Behera v Odisha regarding custodial death?
options: The State is liable to compensate for custodial death
Arrest must not be arbitrary
Procedure must be fair, just and reasonable
Police stations must have mandatory CCTV
mcqs.explanation: Nilabati Behera v Odisha established State liability to compensate for custodial death. The principles concerning arbitrary arrest, fair procedure and CCTV are associated with other cases.

mcqs.question: What principle concerning arrest was laid down in Joginder Kumar v Uttar Pradesh?
options: Arrest must not be arbitrary
The State must compensate for custodial death
Every arrest requires a medical examination of the arrested person
Police Complaints Authorities must be established
mcqs.explanation: Joginder Kumar v Uttar Pradesh held that arrest must not be arbitrary. Compensation for custodial death, arrest-related safeguards and Police Complaints Authorities belong to other listed safeguards.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of custodial safeguards and related legal developments.

List-I
(a) Custodial deaths during 2025–26
(b) D.K. Basu v West Bengal
(c) Prakash Singh v Union of India
(d) Paramvir Singh Saini v Baljit Singh

List-II
(i) Approximately 170 custodial deaths
(ii) Arrest memo, informing a relative and medical examination
(iii) Police Complaints Authorities
(iv) Mandatory CCTV in police stations
options: a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv
a-ii, b-i, c-iv, d-iii
a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii
a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv. The custodial-death figure was approximately 170, D.K. Basu concerned arrest safeguards, Prakash Singh concerned Police Complaints Authorities, and Paramvir Singh Saini concerned mandatory CCTV in police stations.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Congress MP K.C. Venugopal gave a privilege notice against the Law Minister over remarks on opposition MPs during voting on bills.
Statement B: Rule 187 applies to the Rajya Sabha, while Rule 222 applies to the Lok Sabha.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are false. The privilege notice was given by K.C. Venugopal against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and Rule 187 applies to the Lok Sabha while Rule 222 applies to the Rajya Sabha.

mcqs.question:

List-I
(a) Digital India Bhashini
(b) Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita in force
(c) Law Minister
(d) Free legal aid

List-II
(i) 2022, MeitY
(ii) July 1, 2024
(iii) Arjun Ram Meghwal
(iv) Article 39A
options: a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv
a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii
a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii
a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Digital India Bhashini—2022, MeitY; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita in force—July 1, 2024; Law Minister—Arjun Ram Meghwal; and free legal aid—Article 39A. The other codes interchange these details.

mcqs.question: Which incident was linked to Justice Yashwant Varma’s matter during his tenure in the Delhi High Court?
options: Recovery of burnt cash at his residence on March 14, 2025
Recovery of burnt cash at his residence on March 14, 2026
Recovery of burnt cash at his office on March 14, 2025
Recovery of unburnt cash at his residence on March 14, 2025
mcqs.explanation: The matter was linked to the recovery of burnt cash at Justice Yashwant Varma’s residence on March 14, 2025, during his Delhi High Court tenure. The alternatives alter the year, location or condition of the cash.
